errors.text_span: This bar chart illustrates the token ratio for several language models, comparing RedWhale to other models including EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-SN, KoBEST-BQ, and KoBEST-HS.
errors.evidence: The chart compares three models (RedWhale, EEVE-Korean, and SOLAR) across six different evaluation categories (PT-EVAL, the four KoBEST types, and AVG). The description incorrectly identifies the evaluation categories as models.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the model names
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis displays six evaluation categories (PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, etc.), not model names. The model names are listed in the legend.
The categories on the horizontal axis (PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, AVG) are not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: the vertical axis represents the token ratio, ranging from 0.42 to 0.79, with values marked at regular intervals, such as 0.52, 0.56, 0.58, 0.69, 0.74, 0.79
errors.evidence: The vertical axis has no labeled tick marks. The description mistakes the data labels on the bars for axis ticks. Furthermore, the range is incorrect, as several bars have a value of 1.00, which is completely omitted.
The value 0.86 does not appear anywhere in the chart.

errors.text_span: Each bar corresponds to a specific model
errors.evidence: This is a grouped bar chart. Each category on the x-axis has a group of three bars, with each bar in the group corresponding to a different model as defined in the legend. The description incorrectly portrays it as a simple bar chart.
The bars have three distinct colors corresponding to the three models in the legend: dark blue for RedWhale, light blue for EEVE-Korean, and light grey/lavender for SOLAR.

errors.text_span: the RedWhale bar has a value of approximately 0.59
errors.evidence: The description appears to be referencing the 'AVG' category, where the value for RedWhale is 0.57, not 0.59. It also incorrectly refers to a single 'RedWhale bar' when there are six.

errors.text_span: resulting in the tallest bar in the visualization
errors.evidence: The RedWhale bars are never the tallest in any group. The SOLAR bars, with a value of 1.00, are the tallest in every group and in the overall visualization.
The value for the SOLAR model is consistently 1.00 across all six categories, not 0.78.

errors.text_span: The KoBEST models – KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-SN, KoBEST-BQ, and KoBEST-HS – each have token ratios of approximately 0.58, 0.69, 0.69, and 0.74 respectively
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly treats the KoBEST evaluation categories as models and assigns a single, mostly incorrect, value to each. Each KoBEST category is a group of three bars with three different values (e.g., KoBEST-CP has values 0.70, 0.74, and 1.00).

errors.text_span: the average is represented by a bar with a token ratio of approximately 0.59
errors.evidence: The 'AVG' category is not a single bar. It is a group of three bars with values 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The stated value of 0.59 is incorrect.
The description completely fails to mention that the chart is a grouped bar chart, which is a fundamental structural characteristic required by the prompt.
The description omits any mention of the legend, which is essential for understanding the chart as it maps the three models (RedWhale, EEVE-Korean, SOLAR) to their respective bar colors.
